title: Drakoko
description:
A cute'em up in which a mother dragon flies through Dokoland looking for her lost hatchlings, the Kokkos, to save the land from a dark curse. Stages scroll endlessly in every direction, with enemies and items respawning as you fly. The developer describes it as a homage to Yoji Ishii's Flicky, Fantasy Zone and Teddy Boy Blues.

This is a free demo (v1.0) of a game still in development, with the full release funded through Kickstarter. Built with the ZGB engine, heavily modified to support the multidirectional scrolling.
